details: Federal Reserve officials are presenting mixed signals regarding the future path of interest rate increases. While Governor Michael Barr continues to advocate for further tightening to bring inflation down to the 2% target, New York Fed President John Williams emphasized the lack of urgency for another rate hike, suggesting policymakers have time to assess incoming economic data. The market odds for an October rate increase have consequently fallen to around 50%. This comes after the Fed raised its benchmark rate to 3.75%-4.00% in September. Investors are now keenly awaiting upcoming U.S. inflation and employment data for clearer guidance on monetary policy.
title: Fed Officials Show Divergent Views on Future Rate Hikes Amid Inflation Concerns

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) attracted approximately $2.4 billion in inflows during the week ending September 25, bringing 2026's total ETF flows back into positive territory after an earlier deficit. This indicates strong institutional demand for Bitcoin. Despite these significant inflows, Bitcoin's price experienced a pullback, falling towards the $83,000-$85,000 range on September 28 after failing to sustain above $87,000. Macroeconomic pressures, including a stronger U.S. dollar and rising government bond yields, are contributing to a cautious sentiment in risk assets, offsetting some of the positive momentum from ETF investments.
title: Bitcoin Sees $2.4 Billion ETF Inflows Despite Recent Price Dip

details: Bitwise has expanded its suite of single-asset crypto Exchange-Traded Products (ETPs) with the launch of the Bitwise NEAR ETF (NRR) on NYSE Arca in the United States. Trading for NRR commenced on September 29, 2026. This new offering follows Bitwise's existing ETPs for major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, and XRP, further enhancing institutional access and investment avenues for the NEAR Protocol and the broader digital asset market.
title: Bitwise Launches NEAR Protocol ETF (NRR) on NYSE Arca
